$comment: Shared test vectors of the per-flight metrics: app/src/trackEvents.test.ts (flightMetrics) and crates/vectasim-store/src/metrics.rs (derive) both compute every case and compare with `expected`. One 1 Hz sample per row: [t epoch ms, on ground 1/0, ground speed kt, pitch °, AGL ft, gear %, flaps index, latitude, longitude]; approaches carry only what the metrics read (`exceedances` = their number). Generated once, `expected` reviewed by hand.

cases.name: circuit: rotation 2.5 °/s, gear and flaps in the final segment, full stop
airborne start, gear cycled by a go-around, no runway, gates not measurable
lift-off without rotation, touch-and-go then full stop, gear fixed
touch-and-go only: the landing is the last touchdown, its touch-and-go approach counts
no approach ends in the landing touchdown: the last landed approach counts
